execution_order: Serial runs only. Rotate scenario order left by repetition index. Within each matched pair, off/on for even (repetition + original scenario index), on/off for odd.
resource_measurement: Drain surviving attempts after publication; reconcile every coordinator attempt with a local timing.tsv, including injected crashes. Occupied-slot time includes synthetic service delay; CPU uses CLOCK_THREAD_CPUTIME_ID. Report coordinator commit latency, external publication-observation latency, map latency and full drain/process duration separately.
no_spare_rationale: One worker with one physical slot is a saturated control with no other worker on which a backup could execute, even after enough comparable peers complete. Worker count is identical within each off/on pair. Multiworker concurrency limits are validated by gated tests.
acceptance: Retain every run. Require exact serial-oracle output and complete per-attempt timing reconciliation; never filter runs for speedup. Mark incomplete/failed runs explicitly and investigate correctness without changing policy thresholds or schedules.
